Factual items settled from the dossiers: (a) no earnings for either name in the window - all three agree despite differing on NVDA's exact next date, and that agreement is what matters; (b) the apparent drift conflict (Run 2's YTD +20.9 vs +2.9 implying +1pp/biweek to NVDA, against Run 3's MSFT +29% vs NVDA +5.7% since Jul 8) is not a contradiction - MSFT drew ~27% down in H1 then gapped +15.5% on Jul 30 earnings, so both windows are real and the YTD anchor describes a regime that has flipped; I therefore shrink the drift term to zero rather than letting either run's number set the median; (c) Run 1's uncontradicted CR-signed-Sep-2 fact removes Oct 1 shutdown risk from inside the window, trimming one left-tail driver; (d) all three independently searched for a human market and found none matching - Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold candidates differ on instrument, horizon and resolution source, so there is no anchor to blend and I lean on none.
